question: The 18th edition of the Battalion Level Joint Military Exercise Surya Kiran was held in December 2024 between India and ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nepal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **18th edition** of the **Battalion Level Joint Military Exercise** named **Surya Kiran** was conducted in **December 2024**.
 
• This exercise is held **annually** between the armies of **India** and **Nepal**.
 
• **Surya Kiran** focuses on **enhancing interoperability, sharing military expertise**, and strengthening **defense ties** between the two nations.
